questions.question: What is the remainder when x² + 5x + 3 is divided by (x - 4)?
questions.explanation: The remainder theorem says the remainder of dividing P(x) by (x - 4) is P(4). So P(4) = 4² + 5(4) + 3 = 16 + 20 + 3 = 39. No long division is needed.
